answer: At close the protocol clusters this epoch's answer bodies by pairwise copy-score. Each pair above the published cut pays both endpoints 1 unit of this epoch's per-head payout, struck at close and unlendable. A lone island of original text pays 0. A farm of n near-copies pays n-1 units each, so the next raven costs one more unit than the last. The scarce input is uniqueness of this epoch's own text, computed on the live set, so it cannot be pre-aged, split, or reset by a fresh canyon of names. Refuse the levy and the clustered rows are dropped.
